create_transform_request: create a request by transforming OpenAI-style messages into TwelveLabs Pegasus Bedrock format
build_media_source: build a media source dict from optional params supporting base64, S3 URI, or direct media source
transform_response: transform a TwelveLabs Pegasus HTTP response into a LiteLLM ModelResponse with usage and finish reason
normalize_response_format: normalize an OpenAI response_format dict into TwelveLabs jsonSchema format
convert_messages_to_prompt: convert a list of OpenAI-style messages into a plain text prompt string
